brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Built shelf unit from 4x Hex base North half (piece:0,0,0;half-n + piece:0,1,0;half-n lower level and piece:0,0,1;half-n + piece:0,1,1;half-n upper level) providing two stacked levels for book storage. Configurator only checks fit/mesh (check_build meshClash=clear); it does not verify structural load capacity, so 50kg rating cannot be claimed per system rules.
Two drawers installed on cut faces of half bases: drawer:0#0,0#cut and drawer:0#0,1#cut via find_sockets drawer offers.

finish.summary: Built modest 2-level shelf from half-north bases with two cut-face drawers. Mesh clash clear. Load rating for 50kg cannot be verified by configurator (fit-only check) so marked unmet as instructed not to claim load ratings.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
